Schedule Management

Plan and track project timelines using the Critical Path Method. Set dependencies between tasks, identify critical paths, and analyse schedule risk with Monte Carlo simulations.

Schedule Clashes

Schedule clash detection and resource leveling router.

Provides endpoints for:

  • Listing active clashes — Retrieve unresolved schedule conflicts detected by the clash daemon, filtered by severity.

  • Running a portfolio sweep — Trigger a new audit pass to detect resource overallocations, clearance lapses, facility collisions, negative float slips, and predecessor violations.

  • Computing a leveling proposal — Run the Burgess-Killebrew heuristic to propose date shifts that resolve overallocations without extending the critical path.

  • Applying leveling — Commit signed-off leveling shifts to the database in an atomic transaction.

Sub-Tree Locking

The POST /apply-leveling endpoint acquires a sub-tree lock before committing date shifts. This prevents concurrent mutations from interfering with the leveling process. If a lock is already held, HTTP 423 (Locked) is returned.

All endpoints require JWT authentication.

Schedule

Schedule recalculation and export router.

Provides the CPM (Critical Path Method) recalculation endpoint, Monte Carlo Schedule Risk Analysis, and schedule export endpoints for Primavera P6 (.xer) and Microsoft Project (.xml) formats. Export endpoints support defence export sanitization options to redact classified data and mask commercial rates.

Sub-Tree Locking

The CPM recalculation endpoint acquires a sub-tree lock before running the forward and backward passes. This prevents concurrent mutations (e.g., a user editing node dates) from corrupting the calculation. If a lock is already held, HTTP 423 (Locked) is returned.

schedule_quarantine

Schedule quarantine buffer API router.

This module provides the REST API endpoints for the schedule quarantine buffer system. Incoming schedule files (.xer or .xml) are uploaded into a quarantine staging area where automated integrity checks run before any data is merged into the active master schedule.

Endpoints

  • POST /upload — Upload a schedule file into quarantine staging.

  • GET /{id}/issues — Return detected cycles, dangling activities, and calendar clashes.

  • POST /{id}/remediate — Submit graph healing choices.

  • POST /{id}/commit — Merge sanitized batch into active schedule.

Security

All endpoints require JWT authentication via the get_current_user dependency. The uploading user must have sufficient clearance to access the target project.
